title: Collections and Recovery Specialist at Volvo Financial Services (Vilnius or Riga)
description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. What you will do At Volvo Financial Services you will contribute to the transformation of our company, the transport industry and society at large. The Collections & Recovery Specialist plays an important role in supporting portfolio quality and minimizing credit losses across Lithuania, Latvia, and Estonia. The role combines analytical, operational and decision-support responsibilities by monitoring collections performance, preparing portfolio and overdue debt reporting, reviewing contract modification requests, and providing recommendations to support sound credit and collections decisions. The position reports to the Credit Manager at Volvo Financial Services Baltics. Main activities and core responsibilities: • Monitor collections and recovery performance across the Baltic portfolio. • Work with soft collections providers and directly with customers, as needed, to determine cause of delinquency and negotiate payment arrangements. • Prepare and maintain overdue debt (OVD), delinquency and collections performance reports for management. • Ensure data quality and consistency within collections and portfolio management reporting. • Analyze portfolio trends, identify risk areas and recommend corrective actions. • Review customer requests for contract modifications, payment extensions and restructurings. • Perform financial and risk assessment of modification requests and prepare recommendations for approval. • Initiate and handle termination of contracts due to default. • Coordinate Repossession and support Remarketing functions as required. • Support decision-making by providing portfolio, collections and recovery insights. • Monitor recovery performance and support actions aimed at maximizing recovered amounts. • Lead periodic collection meetings to discuss individual accounts and action items. • Drive continuous improvements in collections, recovery and contract administration processes. • Support implementation of new tools, products and business initiatives impacting collections activities. Who are you? In this role, you will bring: • University degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or a related field. • Minimum 3 years of experience in collections, credit, risk management, accounts receivables or financial analysis. Experience in a customer service or similar environment is an advantage. • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. • Ability to assess financial risks and identify appropriate mitigation actions. • Good understanding of leasing and loan products. • High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities. • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. • Experience working in an international and multicultural environment is an advantage. • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. • Fluency in Lithuanian or Latvian and advanced level of English. What’s in it for you? We offer a solid package of compensation and benefits, plus you will enjoy: • Joining a global and diverse team of highly skilled professionals who make customers win. • Opportunity to grow both personally and professionally. • Space to initiate and implement improvements that create value for customers and the business. • Environment where we work with passion, trust each other and embrace change to stay ahead. • Package of company benefits such as trainings, additional health insurance and more. Salary level: from 2.900€ to 3.600€ per month gross (before withholding taxes) depending on skills and experience. Also, annual bonus program will be applied in accordance with the Company policy. Ready for the next move? If you are a proactive professional with strong analytical capabilities, customer focus and integrity, we would like to meet you. Apply now to join Volvo Financial Services Baltics and help us maintain a healthy portfolio while delivering excellent customer support and sustainable business results. For further information, please contact: Vilma Suchockiene, People & Culture Manager Mob. +370 686 77016; email: vilma.suchockiene@volvo.com We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. title: Market Risk Analyst
description: We are seeking talented professionals to join our Risk Management team. The market risk team plays a central role in analysing, measuring, managing, and communicating the risks associated with the Asset and Origination portfolios, including related hedging strategies. The team is also responsible for independent analysis and for supporting the implementation of new contracts in our risk systems. Regularly report on the performance (P&L) and risks associated with our Asset and Origination portfolios, providing accurate and timely information to stakeholders. Monitor energy market developments, regulatory changes, and their potential impact on our portfolios. Perform comprehensive risk assessments of transactions and deal structures before execution, identifying key risks and proposing appropriate mitigation measures. Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including originators, portfolio managers, analysts, and credit risk teams, to ensure robust risk management and deal viability. Contribute to the continuous improvement of risk management processes and tools by sharing insights and proposing enhancements. We look for a Market Risk Analyst with the skills to future-proof our business and strengthen our market risk team. That includes: Advanced university degree in a quantitative discipline like Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Economics, Engineering or equivalent discipline. Knowledge of valuing and modelling derivatives is preferred. Programming experience (Preferably in Python). Strong attention to detail, integrity, and a proactive team player. Excellent communication skills with the ability to confidently engage with stakeholders. Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of Norwegian is an advantage but not required This position is suitable for candidates with prior experience in energy markets or risk management, as well as talented graduates with an interest in renewable energy markets.

title: PreMaster Program - Management Assistance in FC Area, Focus Controlling
description: In this position you will be taking charge of overseeing business and financials of the cost saving measures put forward by your team. Through understanding of the financial background of these changes you will play an important role in determining the progress of these measures. This will be done through the analysis of expected outcomes and of the commercial status of these changes. In these tasks you will be supported with various teams working around the world (Germany, Hungary, Romania, United States, India and Mexico). title: Msc Thesis - From Code to Road: Evaluation of SIL and HIL Fidelity for Heavy-Duty Electronic Braking
description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. Background: The development of modern Heavy-duty vehicles is becoming increasingly complex due to growing integration of software, electronic sensors and advanced vehicle functions. At the same time, the automotive industry is under continuous pressure to reduce development time and cost, while improving safety, reliability, and product quality. Building and testing physical prototypes is both expensive and time-consuming. For these reasons, the industry is moving towards a left-shifted development and validation process, where testing and verification are performed earlier in the development cycle using simulation and virtual test environments . However, increasing the use of simulation also raises the question of how accurately virtual test environments represent real-world behavior. Different levels of simulation environments, such as Software-in-the-Loop (SIL), Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), and full vehicle testing, provide different levels of realism. Understanding the relationship between these testing methods is therefore necessary when deciding what can be performed virtually and which requires physical vehicle validation. Objective: The objective of this thesis is to come up with scenario-based tests and KPIs to assess the fidelity of SIL and HIL, for heavy-duty Electronic Brake Systems (EBS). EBS controls and coordinates several important vehicle functions, such as anti-lock braking, traction control, rollover and stability control, and brake blending. These functions are provided as examples of potential areas of study, it is not expected to cover all of them. By analyzing the behavior obtained at the different testing levels, the study aims to identify similarities, differences, and limitations between testing methods. The results can contribute to a better understanding of how simulation can support and potentially replace parts of traditional vehicle testing while maintaining confidence in system performance and safety. Desired background: Experience in the following areas is desirable: Python Matlab/Simulink Modelling Embedded control systems Vehicle dynamics This thesis project is intended for 2 students. If this sounds interesting, please send your application before 18th October 2026 For questions about the topic please contact: Martin Lamm - martin.lamm@volvo.com or Quentin Demory - quentin.demory@volvo.com Please note that this position is intended for a pair of students applying together. When submitting your application, please clearly indicate the name of your partner in your CV and/or application. We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. Who we are and what we believe in We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities. Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group . Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. Trucks Technology & Industrial Division hire team players who are ready to create real customer impact. Our decentralized teams work close to our customers, with speed and autonomy, to build what they truly need. Join us to collaborate on innovative, sustainable technologies that redefine how we design, build, and deliver value. Bring your curiosity, your expertise, and your collaborative energy, and together, we’ll turn bold ideas into tangible solutions for our customers and contribute to a more sustainable tomorrow.

title: Thesis Work - Future Value of Residential Flexibility: Aggregation and Service Stacking Across Energy Markets
description: Are you a student looking to apply your knowledge to real-world solutions that support the energy transition? With us, you will have the opportunity to complete your thesis project close to the business, working alongside experienced specialists and tackling challenges where your ideas and perspectives can make a real difference About the Thesis Work At Digital Energy Solutions, we develop Vattenfall's digital solutions that make tomorrow’s energy system more efficient, flexible, and secure. Our work spans technologies such as batteries, e-mobility, solar PV, demand response, automation, and secure IT/OT integration, helping accelerate the transition to fossil freedom. Residential energy assets such as batteries, electric vehicles, solar PV, and heat pumps can provide flexibility to both customers and the electricity system through participation in spot, intraday, and ancillary-service markets. However, the value of these markets changes over time due to variations in prices, competition, system needs, and market design. As a result, market participation strategies need to be flexible and adaptive rather than dependent on a single service or market. This thesis will investigate how aggregated residential energy assets can be dynamically coordinated across multiple energy markets to maximize long-term value. The work may include: Historical market analysis Development of representative asset and household profiles Future market scenarios Optimization and/or simulation modelling Evaluation of different service-stacking strategies The analysis will consider factors such as asset constraints, customer needs, market commitments, forecast uncertainty, and operational costs. Research Question How can an aggregated portfolio of residential energy assets dynamically adapt its service-stacking strategy to create long-term value under changing electricity and ancillary-service market conditions? Expected Outcome The thesis is expected to: Characterize the flexibility potential of aggregated residential assets Analyse how the value of different markets evolves over time Develop a framework for multi-asset aggregation and service stacking Assess the benefits of asset diversity and adaptive market allocation The results will support future residential flexibility offerings and provide recommendations for scalable, adaptive, and customer-centric energy services. This assignment is for one Master's student. We are looking for a student who are about to complete their academic studies and are eager to apply their knowledge in a real-world setting through a thesis project at Vattenfall. You are someone who shares our values and identifies with our principles: Active, Open, Positive and Safety. Master’s student in Energy Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field Fluent in English, written and spoken Experience with Python and market or time-series data is an advantage Experience with optimization, simulation, modelling, and/or data analysis Strong analytical skills and ability to structure complex problems and evaluate trade-offs Familiarity with spot, intraday, balancing, or ancillary-service markets is beneficial Interest in electricity markets, energy flexibility, and residential energy assets Ability to collaborate across disciplines and communicate technical concepts effectively Scope: Master’s thesis (30 ECTS)

description: Ready to steer Bosch's performance? We are looking for analytically strong master’s graduates who will shape data-driven corporate steering with us in our Junior Managers Program and aspire to build a leadership career starting in Controlling.​ Over 12 to 24 months, you will rotate through key controlling and finance departments in Germany and abroad. Your mission: understand business models, build expertise in operational and strategic controlling, and take on initial leadership responsibility in projects—ranging from performance analysis to M&A deals—guided by top executives.​ What you will learn and develop with us:​ You will learn how global corporate goals are translated into measurable KPIs and how the financial performance of a tech company is steered to enable data-driven decisions.​ You will actively co-create the financial planning, reporting, and analysis for our business units and evaluate strategic projects such as M&A transactions.​ You will work with modern controlling instruments, BI systems, and agile methodologies to further develop Bosch’s financial steering architecture. title: Developer & Business Analyst - Trading Systems
description: We have developed our own Commodity Trading Risk Management (CTRM) system that covers all aspects of our business activities across the globe: from trade entry through middle-office with P&L reporting and price risk management down to invoicing and for whichever commodity we are trading: electricity, renewables, gas, crude oil, refined products, biofuels, or carbon certificates. Vitol is unique in the energy trading world in making our CTRM the core of our business processes that everyone at Vitol works with, often on a daily basis. As a member of the CTRM team, located in Geneva, Switzerland, you will: Actively contribute to the development of our core system by developing new features based on user requirements to meet our evolving business needs Work closely with a wide range of users to identify & prioritize requirements and design technical solutions Maintain & further improve system modules, including the ones you will help build but also existing ones Provide business applications support and training to users on day to day issues Running a systems integration with a company we’ve acquired Our core technologies, including PL/SQL and Oracle Forms Builder, are still an important part of what we do, and they have enabled the Vitol success story. When you join, you will work with our established technologies to get familiar with the data model and business logic, and quickly start adding value to our business. For those interested, we will also create opportunities further down the line to be part of this important technology migration. University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent field Proven data modelling skills to translate business situations into data structures, proficiency in SQL At least 3 years’ experience in similar position(s), e.g. as a user-facing DB engineer Entrepreneurial drive, ability to work independently as well as in a team Proactive and user-focused “make it work” mentality with a genuine interest in the functional as well as technical aspects of each challenge encountered; comfortable with daily release cycle model Excellent communication and interpersonal skills Full proficiency communicating in English in a business context (verbally & in writing) Qualifications and skills that will help you stand out Experience with PL/SQL (preferred) or a similar procedural DB programming language (e.g. T-SQL) Previous experience in the commodities and/or trading industry Practical experience with Oracle Forms builder Nice to have: experience with programming in C#, C++ or Python French language skills a plus (but not required) Office based role (1 day per week home office)

title: (Senior) Commercial Intraday Analyst (m/f/d)
description: You will join Statkraft’s Continental Intraday Trading organisation, where we develop and operate the algorithmic trading platform and specialised algorithms used to balance renewable generation in short-term power markets. Working closely with traders, dispatchers and market specialists, you will contribute across the algorithm lifecycle—from analysis and backtesting to implementation and live operation. In this role, you will: Design, develop and improve trading algorithms for intraday markets and the balancing of renewable portfolios. Write clean, structured and maintainable code, supported by appropriate testing, documentation and peer review. Work along the full algorithm lifecycle—from market analysis, modelling and backtesting to deployment, monitoring and performance improvement. Contribute to the architecture, reliability and scalability of our algorithmic trading platform. Adapt algorithms to support business expansion in Spain, France and Italy, reflecting local market design and operational requirements. Work closely with traders, dispatchers and market specialists to translate commercial needs into robust technical solutions. Use market data, live performance and operational feedback to improve trading outcomes and contribute to team deliveries. As Intraday Power is trading continuously, 24/7 at 365 days a year, you will be part of a business hours day-shift system . You will be expected to assist through daytime standby duties on weekends or public holidays on an as-need basis, preferably from home. Special situations might require presence in the office. We are looking for a quantitative professional who combines software development skills with commercial curiosity and an interest in European power markets. The depth of experience will determine whether you join at Analyst or Senior Analyst level. You should bring: A strong university degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science, Engineering, Quantitative Finance or a comparable quantitative discipline. Relevant experience in quantitative development, algorithmic trading, energy trading or a related environment; deeper professional experience is expected for the Senior Analyst level. Strong Python skills and the ability to write structured, tested and maintainable code; experience with Git and code review is an advantage. A sound foundation in statistics, time-series analysis, optimisation or data-driven modelling, together with an interest in applying machine learning and modern AI tools to trading problems. An understanding of short-term power trading and European market mechanisms, or a strong motivation to develop it; experience in Spain, France or Italy is an advantage. A structured, quality-focused way of working and the ability to connect technical solutions with commercial needs. Strong communication skills and fluent English; German, Spanish, French or Italian is an advantage.

description: Working in Corporate Strategy The Corporate Strategy function supports the CEO and Corporate Management in setting and driving Statkraft’s strategic agenda. The Corporate Strategy team develops the Group’s corporate strategy, evaluates corporate portfolio perspectives, and advises on capital allocation, strategic priorities, and selected early-phase M&A opportunities. title: Thesis Work - Identifying distributed energy resources from consumption patterns
description: Are you a student looking to apply your knowledge to real-world solutions that support the energy transition? With us, you will have the opportunity to complete your thesis project close to the business, working alongside experienced specialists and tackling challenges where your ideas and perspectives can make a real difference. About the Thesis Work Vattenfall Research & Development (R&D) drives innovation to accelerate fossil freedom and create value across Vattenfall. The Customer Products & Solutions (CPS) Analytics Programme develops data-driven methods and AI-powered solutions to address challenges and opportunities within customer and energy-system domains. This thesis will be conducted within the Analytics Programme at Vattenfall R&D in close collaboration with the Data & Analytics group in Business Area Customers & Solutions in the Netherlands. The growing adoption of distributed energy resources is transforming electricity production and consumption. Technologies such as electric vehicles, heat pumps, battery storage systems, and solar PV create new forecasting challenges while also enabling more flexible and efficient energy services. Better insight into these resources could help customers optimize energy use and flexibility while supporting a more reliable energy system. The thesis will investigate how distributed energy resources can be identified from electricity consumption data using data-driven and machine learning approaches. The project will explore load disaggregation and classification techniques to detect characteristic consumption patterns associated with specific energy resources. Improved visibility of customer assets can support applications such as load forecasting, grid planning, flexibility markets, and customer-centric energy services. The purpose of this thesis is to evaluate the feasibility and accuracy of identifying distributed energy resources from electricity consumption data. The student will: Review relevant literature on load disaggregation and energy asset identification. Develop and evaluate machine learning and statistical models for detecting distributed energy resources from consumption patterns. Assess model performance, limitations, and uncertainty. Provide recommendations for future implementation and research. We are looking for 1 student who are about to complete their academic studies and are eager to apply their knowledge in a real-world setting through a thesis project at Vattenfall. You are someone who shares our values and identifies with our principles: Active, Open, Positive and Safety. Currently enrolled in a Master’s programme in Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering Physics, Energy Systems, or a related quantitative field. Proficiency in English Knowledge of statistical modelling and machine learning. Experience with Python and commonly used data science libraries. Experience with time-series analysis and predictive modelling. Interest in energy systems, electrification, and the energy transition. Master’s thesis, 30 ECTS credits.

title: Thesis Work – Local Energy Resilience Hubs During Crises
description: Are you a student looking to apply your knowledge to real-world solutions that support the energy transition? With us, you will have the opportunity to complete your thesis project close to the business, working alongside experienced specialists and tackling challenges where your ideas and perspectives can make a real difference. About the thesis project At Digital Energy Solutions, we develop Vattenfall’s digital solutions that enable more efficient, flexible, and secure energy systems. This thesis project, conducted in collaboration with the Church of Sweden and Uppsala University, explores how selected church properties can function as local energy and resilience hubs during power outages and other disruptions. The project will investigate how churches can provide essential services such as heating, lighting, communication, charging, and safe gathering spaces, while identifying the technical, organizational, and financial conditions needed to make such solutions feasible. The thesis may include Mapping the needs and incentives of key stakeholders, such as parishes, municipalities, energy companies, grid operators, and local communities. Evaluating business and collaboration models for resilience hubs. Conducting interviews, surveys, and workshops. Assessing critical electricity loads and the potential role of batteries and bidirectional electric vehicle charging. Research question How can selected church properties function as local energy and resilience hubs during electricity outages and other disruptions, and what technical, business, and collaboration arrangements are needed to enable and operate such solutions? title: Manager, Deal Finance & M&A
description: Manager, Deal Finance & M&A Location: Cambridge UK Introduction to the Role: AstraZeneca continues to pursue value-enhancing transactions that supplement its product portfolio and development pipeline, and to deliver maximum value from existing assets through the partnerships, collaborations, out- licences and divestments that create value and share risk. AstraZeneca Business Development is a globally integrated organisation with world-class capabilities in strategic planning, search & evaluation, transaction execution and alliance & integration management. It is varied, fast-moving work that offers an unrivalled opportunity to ‘make a difference ’. Within it, Deal Finance leads the financial aspects of Business Development and M&A — valuation, financial analysis and deal structuring — and provides dedicated support in the negotiation and execution of transactions globally. As a valued member of Deal Finance, the Manager provides dedicated financial support in evaluating and executing M&A, licensing, spin-out, collaboration and other structured transactions, working closely with senior Deal Finance colleagues. It is an ideal move for someone with a keen interest in the pharmaceutical industry who thrives in a fast-paced environment — whether taking their first step into industry or broadening their finance business-partnering skills — and who is genuinely excited about using AI to work smarter. Deal Finance is reimagining valuation and deal analysis for the AI era. You’ll use generative AI and automation to accelerate research, due diligence and modelling — freeing you to focus on judgment, insight and the relationships that close great deals. Here, technical skill and sharp commercial judgment are amplified by AI. Main responsibilities Support the construction of business cases, ensuring that all key issues, sensitivities and risks are evaluated and accurately reflected. Build accurate valuation and transaction models, using automation and AI-assisted tooling, that reflect the expected financial statement implications of potential transactions. Use generative AI and advanced analytics to accelerate industry research and company and product analysis, drawing insight from large, unstructured datasets. Provide input into deal structuring, supporting the assessment of transaction value and financial terms, including review of contracts and term sheets for their financial implications. Support financial due diligence, coordinating with AZ tax, accounting and treasury experts as required . Present findings, alongside a senior Deal Finance colleague, to AZ senior management and other internal decision-making bodies, and support the preparation of financial sections of papers and briefings. Work across multiple deals at different stages of the deal cycle, using excellent time management and prioritisation. Help embed AI and automation within Deal Finance, sharing what works and building reusable tools and templates. Essential requirements A strong academic and professional foundation — degree from a leading university, plus ideally a relevant quantitative or financial qualification (ACA, CFA, MBA or equivalent), or working towards one . Financial fundamentals — a solid understanding of cash vs. profit and of value-based cashflow metrics, plus a working knowledge of relevant technical accounting principles. Financial analysis and modelling — strong financial analysis, valuation and financial-modelling skills (particularly MS Excel), with confident, clear storytelling. Data analysis — the ability to collate, clean and analyse large datasets to surface the key drivers of value and risk . AI curiosity — comfort adopting new technology using AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, research and modelling, paired with the judgment to challenge and validate their output. A compelling communicator — able to convey financial recommendations to both financial and non-financial audiences in a concise, collaborative and impactful way. Energetic, resilient and tenacious — able to manage multiple projects under tight timelines in a fast-paced environment, working both independently and as part of multifunctional transaction teams. Genuine curiosity — a keen interest in business development, emerging technology and the wider pharmaceutical industry. Desirable requirements Industry experience — ideally within a Biotech or Pharma corporate environment. Hands-on AI and data tooling — experience with generative AI, machine learning,

Umfassende Zusatzleistungen: Zugang zu zahlreichen sozialen Leistungen eines Großunternehmens, einschließlich der Teilnahme an innerbetrieblichen Gesundheits- und Sportprogrammen. Attraktive Vergünstigungen: Nutzung der Werkskantine zu vergünstigten Konditionen sowie exklusive Bosch-Mitarbeiterrabatte. title: Thesis Work - Fusion energy – Technical challenges for fusion based power production
description: Are you a student looking to apply your knowledge to real-world solutions that support the energy transition? With us, you will have the opportunity to complete your thesis project close to the business, working alongside experienced specialists and tackling challenges where your ideas and perspectives can make a real difference . About the Thesis Work At Vattenfall R&D and the Section Energy Systems & Processes we actively work to enable society’s energy transition. Our work covers a broad range of topics, from energy system analysis and evaluation of new fossil-free production technologies to fossil-free materials and analyses of the value chains required to make the transition happen. Fusion energy has been a research field funded by public research programs for decades, often through international consortia and with long development horizons. In recent years, however, a clear shift has emerged. Numerous private fusion companies have been established, primarily financed through private capital, with strong expectations of rapid technological progress and commercialization of fusion power. For Vattenfall, it is important to understand both the opportunities and challenges associated with this technology in order to assess what is required for commercial fusion power to become a reality. The purpose of this thesis project is to take a deep dive into some of the technical challenges that must be solved to enable commercial fusion power production. Two suggested focus areas are: Fuel injection. How can fuel be supplied to the reactor in a way that sustains a fusion reaction capable of delivering sufficient energy production over time? Energy extraction. How can the energy released from fusion plasma be extracted and converted into electricity generation? The objective of the thesis work is to identify the most promising technical solutions based on publicly available information, analyze and assess their technical maturity, and evaluate what will be required for successful implementation. The study should include simplified energy and process calculations. The assignment is for one student. We are looking for a student who are about to complete their academic studies and are eager to apply their knowledge in a real-world setting through a thesis project at Vattenfall. You are someone who shares our values and identifies with our principles: Active, Open, Positive and Safety. Education: Master of Science (M.Sc.) student (Civilingenjör in Swedish) in Applied Physics, Chemistry, Energy Systems, or a related field. Language proficiency: English or Swedish. Scope: 30 credits.

title: M&A Principal
description: Entity: Finance Job Family Group: Strategic Planning & Business Development Group Job Description: bp’s corporate Mergers & Acquisitions team's anchor role is to provide a center of expertise in driving acquisitions, disposals, joint ventures and asset restructurings within the bp Group, with a value in excess of US$50 million. M&A's core expertise lies in its advisory and transactional ability. On the advisory side we have knowledge and experience in analysing assets and/or businesses to establish sources of value and minimising risks and liabilities. On the transactional front our experience and skills are deployed in assessing the market, pricing and bidding, running sell-side auctions, negotiation, and project management of a transaction to completion. This involves close collaboration with Business Groups and Functions internally and numerous external parties including corporates, investment banks, engineering firms, financial investors and advisors. We develop a broad corporate development capability through our access to the internal strategic context and an acute awareness of the evolving external market. M&A works with the Business Groups to evaluate divestment and acquisition options. The M&A team plays a pivotal role in bp deliver its strategy. As a Principal in Mergers & Acquisitions, you can expect to be working on several transactions at any one time. The Principal is responsible for leading a transaction team, working closely with business managers, legal, functional, and (in certain instances) financial advisors to effectively deliver material transactions for the bp Group within the boundaries set by the bp executive team. This position provides a unique opportunity for an individual to hone commercial astuteness, negotiating skills, and project management skills. It also provides unparalleled exposure to C-Suite executives and senior leaders across bp. This position is an excellent opportunity for a motivated individual to be exposed to a broad range of business issues and to test themselves in a high pressure transaction environment. This role is based in London and is part of bp’s global M&A team. Applicants with energy backgrounds in upstream, downstream and Trading will be considered. The successful applicant will tag into either the VP M&A Upstream and Technology or the VP M&A Downstream & ST&S, subject to the candidates experience/ background. Notwithstanding, the M&A function works in an agile way, so resources are deployed as needed to meet Group needs. As such, the successful candidate may be deployed to lead transactions across any business segment within the bp Group. Key Accountabilities: End-to-end delivery of a transaction, managing all the relevant resources in a timely manner with all pertinent issues addressed. Leadership of the deal team including all necessary supporting functional expertise to deliver transactions in a timely manner and securing the best value for bp Acting as a key member of the negotiating team (typically the lead negotiator) to secure the deal at maximum value for bp. Support transactions which will help shape bp in the delivery of its corporate strategy and will participate in the implementation of the strategy of all business divisions. Extensive travel could be required but will be dependent on the project portfolio of the M&A Principal and the needs of the business clients. Requirements for the role: Degree from an accredited college or university Consistent track record in delivery of material M&A transactions in the energy industry (hydrocarbon, low carbon, mobility, energy retail) - As part of the interview process, we expect candidates will be able to provide a deal sheet of completed transactions and be able to speak to their role in those. Deep experience working in or with an International Energy Company with career anchor/ experience in at least one operating segment of upstream oil and gas, downstream or trading. Demonstrated negotiation skills and experience with commercial contractual frameworks, risk allocation structures, governance frameworks, etc. Experience with corporate finance, economic evaluation and risk management. Confirmed experience of working with external counterparties in international environments. Experience creating and delivering commercial solutions to challenging problems with joint venture partners, host governments or transaction counterparties. Well developed understanding of energy value chains and macroeconomic themes

title: Senior HR Controller d/w/m Corporate Controlling, MSF & HR Controlling
description: RWE Offshore Wind GmbH Start zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt, Vollzeit / Teilzeit, unbefristet Als Senior HR Controller (d/f/m) bist du Teil des Teams Management Support Functions & HR Controlling in dem schnell wachsenden Offshore Wind Business. Das Team ist verantwortlich für das HR Controlling, insbesondere für die Personalplanung und das Reporting für die gesamte Offshore Organisation. Darüber hinaus trägt das Team dazu bei, dass die Offshore Wind Management Support Funktionen ihre finanziellen Ziele in einem internationalen Geschäftsumfeld erreichen. Die Rolle Du fungierst als HR Controlling Business Partner:in für das Senior Management (Direktor:innen) In Zusammenarbeit mit HR koordinierst, realisierst und optimierst du die HR-Mittelfristplanungs- und Forecasting-Prozesse global über Teams, Rechtseinheiten und Länder hinweg. Du entwickelst auch den Prozess zur Konsolidierung der Daten weiter Zudem prüfst, bewertest, kommentierst und hinterfragst du die von den jeweiligen Abteilungen bereitgestellten Planungsdaten für den Mittelfristplanungs-, Forecasting- und Budgetierungsprozess Du überwachst sowie analysierst die Personalkostenentwicklung. Darüber hinaus schaffst du Transparenz über die tatsächliche Kostenentwicklung im Vergleich zum Budget, zu mittel- bis langfristigen Finanzzielen und Benchmarks, z. Dies umfasst auch die Präsentation der wichtigsten Ergebnisse auf Top-Management-Ebene Du verantwortest die Aufrechterhaltung und Weiterentwicklung des Kostencontrollings, eines umfassenden Rahmens für Gewinn- und Kostenstellen und einer erhöhten Genauigkeit der Kostenzuweisungen Du konsolidierst die Personaldaten sowie -kommentare für vierteljährliche Ist-Berichte, Prognosen und Planungen Eine weitere vielfältige Aufgabe ist die weitere Verbesserung der Qualität und Digitalisierung des HR Management Reporting & Tools, der Controlling Prozesse sowie der IT-Landschaft Du übernimmst Verantwortung in Sonderprojekten wie IT-Optimierungen, Reorganisationen oder strategischen Planungen, indem du deine HR-Controlling-Expertise einbringst. Generell verstehst du dich in deinem Job als Schnittstelle zu verschiedenen Stakeholdern in Human Resources, Controlling und Business Funktionen zu unterschiedlichen HR Controlling Themen Dein Profil Du hast dein Hochschulstudium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs, idealerweise mit den Schwerpunkten Controlling, HR oder Finanzen mit sehr guten Ergebnissen abgeschlossen Darüber hinaus punktest du mit mehrjähriger relevanter Berufserfahrung und nachweisbaren Erfolgen im Controlling - vorzugsweise im HR-Controlling - in HR-relevanten Bereichen wie z.B. Stelleneinstufung und -vergütung, Rekrutierung, Auswahl, Weiterbildung, Sozialleistungen und Chancengleichheit sowie im Finanzbereich Dein umfassendes betriebswirtschaftliches Wissen erstreckt sich auf die Energiewirtschaft und die IT. description_en: The role You act as an HR controlling business partner for senior management (directors). In collaboration with HR, you coordinate, implement and optimize the HR medium-term planning and forecasting processes globally across teams, legal entities and countries. You also further develop the process for consolidating the data. You also check, evaluate, comment on and question the planning data provided by the respective departments for the medium-term planning, forecasting and budgeting process. You monitor and analyze the development of personnel costs. In addition, you create transparency about the actual cost development compared to the budget, medium to long-term financial goals and benchmarks, e.g. B. via the position plan The independent creation of high-quality management reports, presentations and ad hoc analyzes for senior management is also part of your tasks. This also includes the presentation of the most important results at top management level You are responsible for maintaining and further developing cost controlling, a comprehensive framework for profit and cost centers and increased accuracy of cost allocations You consolidate the personnel data and comments for quarterly actual reports, forecasts and planning Another diverse task is the further improvement of the quality and digitalization of the HR management reporting & tools, the controlling processes and the IT landscape You take responsibility in special projects such as IT optimizations, reorganizations or strategic planning by bringing in your HR controlling expertise. In general, in your job you see yourself as an interface to various stakeholders in human resources, controlling and business functions on different HR controlling topics

Executive presence with the ability to build credibility quickly, communicate with clarity and confidence, and influence senior executive leadership at forums such as Audit Committee, the Data Enablement Council, or SET-area Data Office (SEDO), promoting a culture of responsible and confident Data & AI use. title: Senior OT Network & Systems Engineer - Battery Energy Storage Systems - Volvo Energy
description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. Working at Volvo Energy is different Do you want to make the world a better place and love architecting digital solutions? Welcome to a team unified by an important mission, great ideas, fun, diversity, and inclusiveness. Our colleagues are - and will always be - the most important part of the story. Whilst demands are high, there is also plenty of opportunities to learn and grow - as a professional and as a person. We look for colleagues that thoroughly enjoy our intrapreneurial journey, can hit the ground running and lead with passion, perform with purpose and transform with vision. Moreover, it will be essential you have a strong ability to form trustful relationships to effectively work with partners - inside and outside of the Volvo Group – in a cross-functional manner. You will make a difference! Volvo Energy Digital & IT Digital & IT is a function within Volvo Energy. We support our customers transition to a carbon-free world through great Digital solutions and experiences that users love and enables customers to shift to fossil-free operations. We truly care about the customer’s business in terms of up-time, safety, productivity and of course 100% green energy supply. We aim at having industry-leading simplicity and usability for our digital services, such as routing, find-book-pay and charging operator systems. The energy transition will not come for free – but we are committed to support this transition by hard and dedicated work. So - what are we looking for in this specific role? Volvo Energy is providing a highly qualified digital platform, an Energy Management System (EMS), to control our Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS). We are now looking for Senior OT Network & Systems Engineer that will support in establishing cyber secure connectivity towards BESS units and the BESS digital twin using the appointed Volvo Energy Site Controller. As the energy space rely on standards for interoperability between energy systems, like Modbus, IEC 60870-5, 61850 and DNP-3, you make sure that the IoT Edge solution is designed according to cyber security standards. You also ensure cyber secure connectivity to the Volvo Energy EMS solution via MQTT/OPC-UA as defined by the Volvo Energy target architecture. You will work closely together with several different qualified teams to help design and build the solution and report functionally to the Volvo Energy Head of Enterprise architecture. Key Responsibilities In this role, you’ll take the lead in shaping the OT network architecture that powers our BESS units around the world. You’ll design secure, scalable network environments—everything from segmentation and VLAN structures to DMZ zones and redundancy strategies—both for our own products and for customer sites. As the technical owner of our OT networking landscape, you’ll create and maintain clear, high‑quality diagrams and documentation that bring structure to complex systems and ensure smooth integration with cloud platforms and external SCADA/EMS solutions. A big part of your work will center around cybersecurity. You’ll define modern firewall rulesets built on IEC 62443 and zero‑trust principles, validate safe communication paths for industrial protocols like Modbus, and take full responsibility for the lifecycle of our OT firewalls. That includes firmware updates, patching strategies, redundancy testing, vendor coordination, and the automated deployment of configurations across our global BESS fleet using FortiManager. You’ll also play a hands-on role in our production environments—diving into troubleshooting, leading root‑cause analysis, and contributing to cybersecurity assessments and audits that strengthen our defenses. Collaboration will be at the heart of your everyday work. You’ll partner with engineering teams at our assembly plants to ensure firewalls are configured correctly from the moment a unit is built, and you’ll work with Digital/IT teams to define secure, future‑proof IT–OT demarcation points. Along the way, you’ll also share your expertise with junior engineers and project teams, helping them grow while raising the overall technical bar. Required Qualifications 7+ years in OT networking, indus

title: Director Strategic Advice - Quality Science & Strategy
description: Do you want to shape how artificial intelligence is adopted responsibly in a global, science-led biopharmaceutical company? Come join us at AstraZeneca in the role as a Director Strategic Advice - Quality Science & Strategy . This is a rare opportunity to define, from the ground up, how a regulated organization adopts and governs artificial intelligence responsibly. You will set the guardrails, build the framework, and act as the trusted bridge between the technical realities of AI and the regulatory, quality, and business considerations that shape our industry. If you enjoy translating complex technology into clear, workable strategy — and influencing senior leaders to make sound decisions in a fast-evolving field — this role gives you the scope and impact to do exactly that. What you’ll do Provide proactive and strategic quality leadership in AI and data integrity : Lead the development of quality strategy and oversight approaches for AI-enabled, data-driven, and digitally supported activities across R&D, with a particular focus on trustworthy, reliable, and transparent use of data and algorithms. Establish guardrails — requirements, policies, and standards — for how AI is deployed in a regulated setting, including how data must be handled, governed, and used. Influence and build alignment with senior leaders , guiding strategic decision-making on AI adoption. Shape governance for AI- and data-related risk by providing clear insight, reporting, and recommendations to relevant decision-making forums. Maintain an external focus on AI, digital regulation, and data governance: Drawing on expert communities and networks to stay current with evolving AI regulations, standards, and industry practices, and translating these into practical guidance for the organization. Collaborate with and influences external stakeholders and regulatory bodies , representing AstraZeneca’s quality position and helping to shape expectations in evolving areas of science and technology. Provide expert input into quality and compliance risk management , including identification, assessment, mitigation planning and monitoring. Lead or support due diligence activities, inspections, audits and critical quality issue management , ensuring timely resolution and organizational learning. Essential Skills/Experience Significant experience in a regulated industry — pharmaceutical is preferred, but we welcome candidates from medtech, IVD, diagnostics, digital health, or other highly regulated sectors with transferable governance experience. title: Business Controller
description: Do you enjoy driving business performance from a central finance position? Are you an experienced finance professional who can turn complex financial data into strategic insights? Do you thrive in a role where you oversee the bigger picture, steer reporting processes, and support senior management with decision-making? We are looking for a Business Controller to join the Business Control team within Vattenfall's rapidly growing E-Mobility Business Unit. In this central controlling role, you will be responsible for providing insights into the overall financial performance of the Business Unit. You will act as a key partner to senior management, ensuring high-quality financial reporting, forecasting, planning, and performance steering across multiple countries and business areas. Working closely with Business Control colleagues, Finance teams, and senior stakeholders, you will help translate financial results into actionable insights that support the continued growth and development of Vattenfall's E-Mobility business. What will you do? As Senior Business Controller, you will play a key role in steering the overall financial performance of the E-Mobility Business Unit and ensuring a reliable and efficient reporting framework. You will: Coordinate and steer the monthly performance reporting cycle for the overall Business Unit. Consolidate financial results across countries, functions, and business areas into clear management reporting. Deliver insights and analyses on business performance, key value drivers, risks, and opportunities. Lead forecasting activities and translate business developments into reliable financial outlooks. Drive the annual budget and business planning process for the Business Unit. Support senior management with strategic analyses, business cases, and decision-making. Further develop and improve reporting standards, controlling processes, and governance frameworks. Ensure consistency, accuracy, and transparency in financial reporting and performance measurement. Collaborate closely with Business Controllers, Accounting, and Finance teams across different countries. Identify opportunities to automate and enhance reporting tools, KPIs, and management information. Contribute to cross-functional improvement initiatives that support the continued growth of E-Mobility. You will report to the Director of Business Control E-Mobility and work closely with stakeholders across multiple countries and disciplines. Who are you? You are able to combine strong analytical capabilities with a strategic mindset and enjoy understanding how financial performance connects to broader business objectives. You are comfortable working with large amounts of data, creating structure in complex environments, and translating financial outcomes into meaningful insights for senior stakeholders. You can switch effortlessly between detailed financial analysis and high-level performance discussions. With a proactive and collaborative approach, you build strong relationships across the organisation and contribute to continuous improvement. We believe you bring: At least 7 years of experience in Business Controlling, Financial Controlling, FP&A, Corporate Finance, or a similar finance-related role. A master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. Experience with consolidated reporting, forecasting, and business planning in a complex international organisation. Strong analytical and financial modelling skills. Experience working with senior stakeholders and management teams. The ability to translate complex financial information into clear and actionable recommendations. Advanced Excel and presentation skills; experience with SAP and reporting tools is highly valued. Full professional proficiency in English. Experience within the utilities, energy, infrastructure, or other asset-intensive industries is considered an advantage. Location: Berlin, Stockholm or Amsterdam

title: Werkstudent (d/m/w) im Bereich Technical Quality Analytics, KPI Reporting & Management Support
description: Job Description: Zur Unterstützung in der Quality, sucht Airbus Aerostructures einen Werkstudenten (d/m/w) – Technical Quality Analytics, KPI Reporting & Management Support Du bist Vollzeitstudent, suchst eine Werkstudentenstelle und möchtest die Arbeit eines Spezialisten für datengetriebene Qualitätssicherung und strategische Kommunikation im Leitungsbereich bei Airbus Aerostructures kennenlernen? Dann bewirb dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, dass du uns im Bereich KQ als Werkstudent (m/w/d) mit ca. 18 Stunden pro Woche unterstützt! Standort: Hamburg Start: Ab sofort Dauer: 12 Monate Bei uns erhältst du ein tarifliches Entgelt je nach Tätigkeit von mindestens 18,53€ pro Stunde. Hinzu kommen Sonderzahlungen wie beispielsweise Urlaubsgeld. Deine Mission Unsere Qualitätsabteilung ist ein dynamisches Umfeld. Um unsere Weltklasse-Standards zu halten, brauchen wir ein technisch versiertes Talent als Bindeglied zwischen dem Top-Management und dem operativen Tagesgeschäft. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Executive Assistant stellst du sicher, dass technische Daten, KPIs und Dokumentationen jederzeit „vorstandsreif“ aufbereitet sind. Dein Standort Du arbeitest in der größten Produktionsstätte für zivile Flugzeuge in Hamburg. Durch die Lage am südlichen Elbufer besteht die Möglichkeit, mit der Fähre zu pendeln. Deine Werkstudentenstelle befindet sich auf dem Werk in Finkenwerder und du kannst vormittags und ab mittags mit der Fähre von Teufelsbrück zum Airbus Fähranleger und zurück zur Uni fahren. Alternativ nimmst du die Fähre bis Finkenwerder und fährst dann ca. 15 Minuten mit dem Fahrrad zum Haupteingang. Erlebe in deiner Freizeit das besondere Flair Hamburgs, wo pulsierende Weltstadtkultur auf nautisches Erbe trifft. Deine Vorteile Attraktive Vergütung und ausgeglichene Work-Life-Balance bei einer 18-Stunden-Woche (Gleitzeit). Internationales Umfeld mit der Möglichkeit, Kontakte in die ganze Welt zu knüpfen. Arbeit mit modernen/abwechslungsreichen Technologien. Wir bei Airbus sehen dich als vollwertiges Teammitglied und du bist nicht zum Kaffee kochen eingestellt worden, sondern stehst im engen Austausch mit den Schnittstellen und bist Teil unserer wöchentlichen Teamrunden. Deine Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten Technische KPI-Auswertung & Reporting: Du unterstützt das Management bei der Erstellung hochkarätiger Präsentationen für Reviews. Dabei übernimmst du die systematische Auswertung technischer Qualitäts-KPIs und übersetzt Rohdaten in klare, aussagekräftige Berichte. Aufarbeitung & Darstellung (Datenvisualisierung): Du bereitest komplexe technische Prozesse, Datenblätter und Analysen strukturiert auf. Durch zielgerichtete Darstellung in Management-Dashboards und leicht verständlichen Infografiken machst du diese greifbar. Digitale Systeme (G-Site): Du begleitest den Relaunch unserer internen Google Site und hilfst dabei, sie – inklusive technischer Kennzahlen – in eine intuitive, visuell ansprechende „Single Source of Truth“ zu verwandeln. Technische Kommunikation: Du verfasst interne Ankündigungen und verantwortest den vierteljährlichen Qualitäts-Newsletter. Hierbei übernimmst du den Prozess von der Recherche und Aufarbeitung der KPIs bis zum fertigen Artikel. Management Support: Du unterstützt die Executive Assistant im Tagesgeschäft und stellst die digitale Dokumentation (inkl. Daten und Trackings) für Meetings sicher. Erforderliche Kenntnisse und Qualifikationen Ausbildung: Derzeit im Studium der Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Kommunikationswissenschaften (mit Technik-Affinität) oder ein vergleichbarer Studiengang. Das „visuelle Auge“ & Analytik: Du hast ein Talent für Datenvisualisierung und kannst eine komplexe Tabelle oder ein komplexes Datenblatt in klare, umsetzbare Erkenntnisse umwandeln. Du weißt, wie man eine Folie professionell, übersichtlich und leicht verständlich gestaltet. Zuverlässigkeit: Du weißt, dass im Bereich Quality 99% nicht ausreichen und hast hohe Ansprüche an deine eigene Arbeit. Tools: Sicherer Umgang mit Google Workspace (Google Slides und Google Sheets oder entsprechende MS Office-Kenntnisse sind unerlässlich). Erfahrung mit Datenvisualisierungstools ist ein Plus. Sprachen: Exzellentes Deutsch und Englisch (Wort/Schrift) ist Voraussetzung. Du hast ein Talent für „Storytelling“ – du kannst technische Daten interessant vermitteln. Mindset: Du arbeitest gerne in internationalen Teams und gehst proaktiv auf Kollegen zu. Bitte lade folgende Unte

title: IT Architect – Energy Business
description: Are you ready to take on the challenge of shaping the future of energy assets? As an IT Architect - at Vattenfall, you will play a pivotal role in driving our mission of achieving fossil free living within one generation. By optimizing and innovating our IT landscape, you will contribute to increasing efficiency and sustainably. Your expertise will contribute to a smarter, more resilient energy system, making a real impact on the environment. What will you do? Your responsibilities will include consulting, supporting and educating the business on IT, integration, and data strategies. title: PhD: Surface Physics and Computational Analytics for Thin-Film Microstructure Characterization
description: Drive cutting-edge research at the intersection of materials science, thin-film engineering, and MEMS innovation. title: Pflichtpraktikum Financial Accounting - General Ledger
description: Mit weltweit über 12 000 Mitarbeitenden verfolgen wir bei Bosch Global Business Services ein gemeinsames Ziel: die Bereitstellung erstklassiger Dienstleistungen, die einen echten Mehrwert für Bosch schaffen. Fortschrittliche Technologie und weltweite Zusammenarbeit sind unsere Treiber, durch die wir jeden Tag einen Unterschied machen. Durch unser einzigartiges Set-up bündeln wir alle kaufmännischen Prozesse unter einem Dach. Das ermöglicht dir, in die spannende Welt von Bosch einzutauchen. Deine Arbeit trägt maßgeblich zur Wettbewerbsfähigkeit von Bosch bei und gibt unseren Geschäftsbereichen den nötigen Freiraum, Technik fürs Leben zu entwickeln. Im Rahmen deines Praktikums bearbeitest du einzelne Themenfelder in der Hauptbuchhaltung von der Bewertung und Bilanzierung bis zur Buchung in SAP und der Erstellung der zugehörigen Dokumentation. Regelmäßig erstellst du Auswertungen zu unterschiedlichen Inhalten im Accounting in unterschiedlichen SAP R/3- und S/4-Systemen. Du leitest erforderliche Anpassungen ein und präsentierst die Ergebnisse. Du überwachst die unterjährige Entwicklung verschiedener Sachverhalte anhand von Sachkonten und/oder Rückstellungen nach HGB und IFRS in SAP R/3 und S/4HANA. Des Weiteren identifizierst du Verbesserungspotentiale bei bestehenden Prozessen, erstellst Wirksamkeitsanalysen, unterstützt bei deren Umsetzung und bei der Kommunikation an unsere Kunden. Sonderaufgaben, wie die Erarbeitung von Prozessdokumentationen, der Aufbau inkl. der Optimierung von Excel-Lösungen und die zielgruppenorientierte Aufbereitung unterschiedlicher Daten und Sachverhalten gehören ebenfalls zu deinem Aufgabenbereich. Deine Mitarbeit bei Tests für die Tool-Weiterentwicklungen als auch bei Automatisierungsprozessen und der Digitalisierung ist gefragt. Ausbildung: Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar Erfahrungen und Know-how: sicherer Umgang mit MS Office (insbesondere Excel); Basiskenntnisse der Bilanzierung nach HGB und IFRS; Grundkenntnisse in der Administration von Applikationen und Datenbanken (IT-automatisierte Datenverarbeitungskenntnisse VBA, KNIME, RPA BOT); SAP-Kenntnisse und praktische Vorerfahrungen in der Buchhaltung von Vorteil Persönlichkeit und Arbeitsweise: dir gelingt es, dich schnell in neue Prozess- und Systemlandschaften einzuarbeiten, dabei komplexe Sachverhalte zu abstrahieren und logisch zu durchdenken, während du deine Aufgaben strukturiert und selbstständig angehst und dich aktiv ins Team einbringst Arbeitsalltag: deine Präsenz vor Ort ist erforderlich Begeisterung: für automatisierte Prozesse und die daraus resultierende Zahlenverarbeitung Sprachen: verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch

Advanced technology and global collaboration are what drive us to make a difference every day. Thanks to our unique set-up, we bundle all commercial processes under one roof. This allows you to immerse yourself in the exciting world of Bosch. Your work contributes significantly to Bosch's competitiveness and gives our business areas the freedom they need to develop technology for life. As part of your internship, you will work on individual subject areas in general accounting, from valuation and accounting to booking in SAP and the creation of the associated documentation. You will also identify potential for improvement in existing processes, create effectiveness analyses, support their implementation and communicate with our customers. Special tasks such as the development of process documentation, the development and optimization of Excel solutions and the target group-oriented preparation of different data and facts are also part of your area of ​​responsibility. Your cooperation in tests for tool developments as well as in automation processes and digitalization is required. Education: Studies in the field of economics, business informatics or comparable Experience and know-how: confident use of MS Office (especially Excel); Basic knowledge of accounting according to HGB and IFRS; Basic

title: Commercial Manager (18-month temporary position)
description: As part of BA Wind you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry with 24GW of capacity stretching out more than a decade ahead across our key European markets. You won’t only be involved in developing projects but pioneering cutting-edge innovation, new business models and ways of working with communities and the environment. Working as part of a leading European utility also means you could be helping a growing number of major businesses and brands achieve their own sustainability goals through partnerships. We are looking for a Commercial Manager to join our Commercial Operations team on a temporary full-time basis for 18 months . In this role, you will have end-to-end commercial responsibility for assigned offshore wind assets in Germany. Acting as the key commercial partner to Site Management, you will manage a broad range of operational contracts, drive commercial performance, and ensure contractual risks and opportunities are effectively managed. Working closely with Operations, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Asset Management, and external suppliers, you will help create commercial value, support efficient operations, and contribute to continuous improvement across the assets. What will you do? Commercial Management Partner with Site Management on commercial, contractual, and financial matters. Provide commercial analysis and recommendations to support operational and strategic decisions. Identify and manage commercial risks and opportunities. Support budgeting, forecasting, and performance reviews. Lead or support commercial negotiations and contract-related discussions. Contract Management Manage operational contracts throughout their lifecycle. Monitor supplier performance and compliance with contractual obligations. Handle contract variations, claims, and commercial disputes where required. Maintain strong relationships with suppliers and key internal stakeholders. Continuous Improvement Drive improvements to commercial processes, reporting, and ways of working. Identify and implement value-creation and cost-saving opportunities. Promote best practices and share lessons learned across assets and functions. Who are you? You are a commercially driven professional with experience in contract and supplier management within a complex operational environment. You combine strong analytical skills with a pragmatic mindset and are comfortable working with both commercial details and broader business objectives. You build strong relationships, communicate confidently with stakeholders at all levels, and take ownership of delivering results. Structured and proactive by nature, you thrive in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift and no two days are the same. Next to this you bring: A degree in a commercial, legal, engineering or similar discipline Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in contract, commercial or procurement roles — preferably in renewables, energy, oil & gas, or other complex industries Experience interpreting, managing, supporting and negotiating commercial agreements supported by a strong commercial mindset Experience with operational renewable energy assets Ability to manage many tasks simultaneously with structure and prioritization Experience working with suppliers and external stakeholders Must be able to manage and negotiate contracts in English German language is a plus, not a must Location: Amsterdam (Netherlands), Kolding or Copenhagen (Denmark), Hamburg (Germany) or London (UK)

title: Director, Analytics Engineering (2 Openings)
description: Job Description Summary #LI-Remote Novartis has an exciting opportunity for a Director, Analytics Engineering. This role is responsible for building next-generation, AI-powered automated data pipelines and scalable data repositories that enable enterprise data science and analytics at scale. By leveraging advanced AI technologies, modern data engineering tools, and feature engineering platforms, this director creates self-service, analytics-ready datasets and enterprise feature stores that empower both expert data scientists and citizen data scientists to rapidly develop, deploy, and scale models. This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. (there may be some restrictions based on legal entity). Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the hiring manager. This position will require 20% travel. There are 2 positions available. Job Description Major accountabilities: Design and implement intelligent, self-healing data pipelines that leverage AI/ML for automated data quality monitoring, anomaly detection, and remediation. Build and maintain centralized feature stores that enable feature reusability across multiple models and use cases. Create curated data repositories optimized for data science/AI workflows, including training datasets, evaluation datasets, and production serving layers. Develop automated feature engineering pipelines that transform raw data into analytics-ready features with lineage tracking. Partner with Enterprise IT to optimize analytics platform architecture for high-performance data science workloads. Build automated pipelines that integrate diverse data sources including sales, CRM, patient claims, real-world evidence, and unstructured data. Create self-service data access layers that empower data scientists and analysts to query and extract data independently. Establish SLAs for data availability, freshness, and quality; implement monitoring and observability solutions. Essential Requirements Advanced degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field; 7+ years of experience in data engineering, ML/AI engineering, or analytics infrastructure. 5+ years leading teams building enterprise-scale data platforms and feature stores. Expert knowledge of feature store technologies (Feast, Tecton, SageMaker Feature Store, Databricks Feature Store). Deep expertise in modern data platforms optimized for ML workloads (Databricks, Auto ML, Snowflake, BigQuery). Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark/PySpark for large-scale data processing. Experience with data orchestration tools (Airflow, Prefect, dbt) and CI/CD for data pipelines. Understanding of data governance, privacy (HIPAA, GDPR), and compliance in life sciences. Preferred Qualities Proven track record of implementing AI/ML-powered automation in data engineering workflows. Strategic thinker who can balance innovation (cutting-edge AI tools) with reliability (production stability). Builder mindset with ability to create scalable, self-service capabilities that reduce dependency on data engineering. Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences industry. Knowledge of streaming technologies, MLOps tools, and data lakehouse architecture. Novartis Compensation Summary: The salary for this position is expected to range between $194,600 and $361,400 per year. The final salary offered is determined based on factors like, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience, and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically. Novartis may change the published salary range based on company and market factors. Your compensation will include a performance-based cash incentive and, depending on the level of the role, eligibility to be considered for annual equity awards. US-based eligible employees will receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, life and disability benefits, a 401(k) with company contribution and match, and a variety of other benefits. In addition, employees are eligible for a generous time off package including vacation, personal days, holidays and other leaves. title: Technical Learning Portfolio Owner
description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. What you will do Job Summary The Technical Learning Portfolio Owner holds global ownership of the Technical Learning Portfolio for dealers. The role ensures that technical competence development enables dealer performance, supports product strategy and drives measurable business impact. Acting as Portfolio Owner and Project Lead for the technical content production team, this role secures prioritisation, execution and quality of global technical learning solutions. The position drives Technical Global Masters competition and is accountable for delivery of Technical Train-the-Trainer (TtT) solutions to regional CD&D functions. title: Head of Global Financial Services
description: Are you looking for a career in an inspiring, global environment where your expertise makes a difference? At Neste, you will be working for the world’s leading producer of renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel, which enable our customers to reduce their greenhouse gas emissions. We are looking for you, Head of Global Financial Services to join our Group Finance organization in Neste headquarters in Espoo. You will focus on leading a global shared service center, Neste Global Financial Services (GFS), which is responsible for timely and accurate monthly, quarterly and annual statutory reporting to internal stakeholders, external auditors and authorities. The service scope includes Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Payments, Asset and Inventory Accounting and General Accounting for Neste subsidiaries across Renewable Products and Oil Products business areas. In this job you will work closely with your own highly skilled GFS leadership team, top-tier finance professionals across the Neste Group, and key function and business stakeholders globally. In our team, you will be part of a well-motivated and experienced group of professionals who are driven to continuously improve our processes and develop our talents. As a team, we aim to elevate our financial operations and support Neste's strategic decision-making. Together with your expertise, we can do meaningful work to drive Neste forward. Reasons to join We operate in an inspiring and evolving business environment as a global leader in renewable fuels. We contribute to Neste’s success by living our values every day: we care, we have courage, we cooperate. We prioritize safety at all times and in every location. We strive to create a positive and impactful work environment. Transformation brings new possibilities and fosters our courage and curiosity. As a global company, we support personal development with versatile learning and career opportunities. Collaboration is key, and we believe in flexible, smart ways of working. We work at the office at least three days a week to ensure seamless teamwork and a sense of belonging. In addition, our benefits for employees in Finland include, for example, a personnel fund as part of the overall remuneration, good occupational health care, a membership in a sickness or health insurance fund and leisure time accident insurance. We also support leisure time activities, e.g. by offering benefits for sports and culture (ePassi). More about the job Your role in our team Leading the Global Financial Services department’s overall performance, including heading your own leadership team of 7 direct reports and an organization of 65+ finance professionals based in Espoo, Finland. Ensuring timely and accurate financial reporting while leading robust financial service processes with strong global internal controls. Maintaining and developing the global service delivery model and fostering strong partnerships with key stakeholders and counterparties. Driving end-to-end process development, continuous improvement, and financial service automation. Participating in IT systems renewals and M&A projects to provide all potential new group companies with scalable, proper financial services. Keys to success in this role Applicable education, e.g., Master’s degree in Accounting or Finance, combined with at least 10 years of relevant work experience. Proven track record in leadership, including providing strategic direction, coaching managers, driving team performance, and fostering global collaboration. Expertise in timely/accurate reporting, internal control frameworks, and running cost management. Solid knowledge of financial processes, systems (especially SAP FI), and accounting principles (IAS/IFRS and Local GAAPs). Experience in end-to-end process development, automation methods (e.g., RPA and AI), and participation in finance IT system projects. Proactive and analytical approach, high adaptability to changing situations, and a strong sense of ownership. Excellent communication skills and a collaborative, positive mindset. Let’s get you started We look forward to receiving your CV and application with a salary request by August 31, 2026. Please note that the review of applications will start already during the application period, so submit your application right away! If you have any questions regarding the process or the position, please get in touch with Kaisa Koivuranta, Vice President, Group Finance +358 50 458 4985 on Friday 14

By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. A peer to the Senior Director, Portfolio Projects, you will own the strategy, talent, standards and delivery of a multidisciplinary team —Portfolio, Finance and Strategic Resource Management teams — and be accountable for turning data into decision-ready analytics applications that internal business users rely on every day. This is a senior people-leadership role. Delivery of analytics applications to business users · Be accountable for delivering robust, usable analytics applications and products to internal business users — from valuation and forecasting tools to resource-planning and KPI dashboards. · Ensure solutions are production-grade, well-supported and adopted, with clear ownership, documentation and user enablement. · Drive reusable platforms, patterns and standards that scale analytics delivery across the function. Partnership, governance & responsible AI · Partner with and influence senior and executive stakeholders, presenting analysis, trade-offs and recommendations that shape investment and resourcing decisions. · Own analytical governance, data quality and methodological rigour across the function’s deliverables. · Champion the responsible, compliant use of Gen AI and advanced analytics in a regulated environment.
